risks: refreshWarmLease reads the token then calls Chtimes as two syscalls: a holder stalled exactly between them (a window of microseconds in a 10 s tick) would, on resuming, touch the successor's lease once before its next tick ends the heartbeat. The implementer's test waits three ticks for this reason (codegraph_test.go:828-830). The effect is one mtime refresh to now on a successor that is live at that instant, extending a successor that then dies by at most one heartbeat interval; there is no seam to pin it deterministically, so it is recorded here rather than as a failure.

A build that exits 0 in the same instant its context ends logs the `ended with its process` line instead of the success line (codegraph.go:219-221); the next launch's status reads the index complete, so only the log line is lost.
